Summarise grading results

Source: R/report.R
grade_report.Rd

Computes pass rate per exercise and score per student, plus counts of errors, timeouts, and missing submissions. The returned object has a print() method that renders a readable console summary.

Usage

grade_report(results, scoring = c("all", "partial"), weights = NULL)

Arguments

results

A grade_results object returned by grade_submissions() or grade_exercise().

scoring

"all" (default): an exercise counts as passed only if every test passes. "partial": it scores the fraction of tests that pass. See student_scores().

weights

Optional named numeric vector of test or exercise weights. See student_scores().

Value

A grade_report object (a list) with components:

pass_rate_by_exercise

Named numeric vector (0-1). Mean exercise score across students.

score_by_student

Named numeric vector (0-1). The student's total from student_scores().

overall_mean

Scalar numeric (0-1).

issue_counts

Named integer vector with counts of error, timeout, missing, and source_error rows.

flagged

Character vector of students with suspicious code or tampering noted in the message column (see scan_code()).

In pass_rate_by_exercise and score_by_student, a missing exercise or one with a source_error counts as 0.

Examples

report <- grade_report(example_results())
report
#> === Grade Report ===
#> 
#> Pass rate by exercise:
#>   ejercicio1                75%
#>   ejercicio2                75%
#>   ejercicio3                62%
#>   ejercicio4                62%
#>   ejercicio5                75%
#> 
#> Overall mean score: 70%
#> 
#> Score by student (descending):
#>   Garcia               ################     80%
#>   Lopez                ################     80%
#>   Martinez             ################     80%
#>   Gonzalez             ################     80%
#>   Rodriguez            ############         60%
#>   Fernandez            ############         60%
#>   Perez                ############         60%
#>   Sanchez              ############         60%
report$score_by_student
#>    Garcia     Lopez  Martinez Rodriguez Fernandez  Gonzalez     Perez   Sanchez 
#>       0.8       0.8       0.8       0.6       0.6       0.8       0.6       0.6
